content.title: Oscars 2026: Where to Watch and What to Expect
content.text: In the world of the Oscars, 2026 has already been a year to remember. The long march of awards season has shaken up our preconceived notions about who is going to win big, and it’s hard to know who will walk away from 98th Academy Awards with a coveted golden statuette. On Sunday night, tune into ABC at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT, to watch it all happen live.Comedian Conan O’Brien is hosting for the second year in the row, and he’ll be the audience proxy for a night of tight races, from the best actor showdown between Timothée Chalamet and Michael B. Jordan and the best picture race, where Paul Thomas Anderson’s critically acclaimed One Battle After Another is neck-in-neck with Ryan Coogler’s record-breaking Sinners. This year also includes one new award: best casting, which honors casting directors for their role in putting together a film’s ensemble.How to Watch the Oscars 2026Starting early, at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT, the show will air on local ABC affiliates. For the second time, it will simultaneously stream live on Hulu in the US, and on services like Hulu + Live TV, YouTube TV, AT&T TV, and FuboTV. Cable or satellite subscribers can watch on ABC.com and the ABC app. The Oscars will also air live in more than 200 territories across the world.In December 2025, the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences announced that the annual telecast would eventually move to YouTube. But until 2029, the show will continue to air on ABC, its longtime home.Who Is Hosting the Oscars 2026?This year, O’Brien is returning as host, following a successful turn at the 2025 Oscars, which included a few jokes about the controversies that surrounded the year’s Oscars race. The telecast itself will be helmed by a familiar team, as last year’s executive producer and showrunner Raj Kapoor, executive producers Katy Mullan and Rob Paine, and director Hamish Hamilton are all returning.Who Is Nominated at the Oscars 2026?With a record-breaking 16 nominations, Sinners is the film to beat, and the enthusiasm was palpable when the cast appeared at the annual Oscars Nominees Luncheon earlier this month. In addition to acting nods for Michael B. Jordan, Delroy Lindo, and Wunmi Mosaku, as well as Ryan Coogler’s first nomination for best directing, the film was nominated for best picture, original screenplay, casting, cinematography, costume design, production design, sound, makeup and hairstyling, song, score, visual effects, and editing.Chloé Zhao’s emotionally devastating Hamnet stars Paul Mescal as William Shakespeare and best actress nominee Jessie Buckley as his witchy, grief-stricken wife, Agnes. Zhao became only the second woman to be nominated twice for best directing, following her win in 2021 for Nomadland. Best director nominee Paul Thomas Anderson’s One Battle After Another ultimately got 13 nominations, including best actor for Leonardo DiCaprio, best supporting actor for Benicio del Toro, and best supporting actress for Golden Globe winner and Vanity Fair cover star Teyana Taylor.
